name: IQ-TREE 3
description: Fast and effective stochastic algorithm for phylogenetic inference by maximum likelihood.
citation: Minh et al. (2020) IQ-TREE 2: New Models and Methods for Phylogenetic Inference. Mol. Biol. Evol. 37:1530-1534.

fields.label: Alignment file
fields.help: Input alignment in PHYLIP, FASTA, NEXUS, CLUSTAL or MSF format.

fields.label: Output prefix
fields.help: Prefix for all output files. Defaults to the alignment filename.

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: Number of CPU cores. Use AUTO to let IQ-TREE detect the optimal number.

fields.label: Sequence type
fields.help: Sequence data type. IQ-TREE auto-detects if omitted; specify for codon analyses.

fields.label: Starting tree
fields.help: Starting tree for search: path to a Newick file, BIONJ, or RANDOM.

fields.label: Fixed user tree
fields.help: Fix this user tree and only compute likelihood without optimising topology.

fields.label: Outgroup
fields.help: Outgroup taxon name to root the tree.

fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Random number seed for reproducibility.

fields.label: Max AUTO threads
fields.help: Maximum cores that -T AUTO is allowed to allocate.

fields.label: Max RAM
fields.help: Maximum RAM usage (e.g. 4G, 512M).

fields.label: Keep identical sequences
fields.help: Keep duplicate/identical sequences in the alignment (removed by default).

fields.label: Safe numerical mode
fields.help: Avoid numerical underflow on large alignments at the cost of speed.

fields.label: Verbose
fields.help: Print more messages to screen.

fields.label: Quiet mode
fields.help: Suppress all screen output.

fields.label: Redo analysis
fields.help: Ignore any existing checkpoint and restart the analysis from scratch.

fields.label: Checkpoint interval (s)
fields.help: Minimum interval in seconds between checkpoint writes.

fields.label: Model / selection strategy
fields.help: Substitution model name (e.g. GTR+G, WAG+I+G4) or selection keyword: TEST, TESTONLY, MF (=TESTNEWONLY), MFP (=TESTNEW), TESTMERGE, MF+MERGE, MFP+MERGE.

fields.label: Restrict model set
fields.help: Restrict model selection to those used by a program (Phyml, RAxML, etc.) or a comma-separated list of model names.

fields.label: Amino acid substitution source
fields.help: Restrict amino acid model selection to models for the specified source.

fields.label: Frequency types
fields.help: Comma-separated frequency types to include in model selection (e.g. F,FO,FQ).

fields.label: Rate heterogeneity types
fields.help: Comma-separated rate heterogeneity categories (e.g. G,I+G,R4).

fields.label: Min FreeRate categories
fields.help: Minimum number of categories for the FreeRate model.

fields.label: Max FreeRate categories
fields.help: Maximum number of categories for the FreeRate model.

fields.label: Selection criterion
fields.help: Optimality criterion for model selection.

fields.label: Full tree search per model
fields.help: Perform a full tree search for each model. Slower but more accurate.

fields.label: Redo model selection
fields.help: Ignore model checkpoint and redo model testing.

fields.label: Additional mixture models
fields.help: Comma-separated mixture models to additionally consider.

fields.label: User model file
fields.help: NEXUS model file defining new or custom substitution models.

fields.label: Relaxed clustering (%)
fields.help: Percentage for the relaxed clustering algorithm (partition merging). Smaller = faster.

fields.label: Fast relaxed clustering (%)
fields.help: Like -rcluster but uses the faster relaxed clustering algorithm.

fields.label: Max partition pairs
fields.help: Absolute maximum number of partition pairs to evaluate.

fields.label: Gamma shape (α)
fields.help: Fix the Gamma shape parameter α. Overrides ML estimation.

fields.label: Invariable sites proportion
fields.help: Fix the proportion of invariable sites. Overrides ML estimation.

fields.label: Gamma median approximation
fields.help: Use median instead of mean for Gamma rate heterogeneity (Yang 1994).

fields.label: Thorough +I+G estimation
fields.help: More thorough estimation of +I+G model parameters (slower).

fields.label: Write site rates
fields.help: Write per-site rates to a .rate file.

fields.label: Partition file (equal rates)
fields.help: Partition file with equal rates across partitions (-q model).

fields.label: Partition file (proportional rates)
fields.help: Partition file with proportional (edge-linked) branch lengths. Equivalent to -p.

fields.label: Partition file (unlinked rates)
fields.help: Partition file with completely unlinked branch lengths per partition. Equivalent to -Q.

fields.label: Guide tree
fields.help: Guide tree for inferring site-specific frequency profiles (e.g. for C60 model).

fields.label: Site frequency file
fields.help: Pre-computed site frequency file.

fields.label: Posterior maximum mode
fields.help: Use posterior maximum (instead of average) for site-specific profiles.

fields.label: Initial parsimony trees
fields.help: Number of initial parsimony trees to generate.

fields.label: Top trees to optimise
fields.help: Number of top parsimony trees passed to full ML optimisation.

fields.label: Candidate set size
fields.help: Number of trees retained in the candidate set.

fields.label: Iterations
fields.help: Number of iterations to run. Set to 0 to skip tree search (compute model only).

fields.label: Stop after N unsuccessful
fields.help: Stop after this many iterations without improving the best tree.

fields.label: Perturbation strength
fields.help: Perturbation strength for randomised NNI (0.0–1.0).

fields.label: Constraint tree
fields.help: Topological constraint tree in Newick format.

fields.label: Thorough NNI
fields.help: More thorough but slower NNI search.

fields.label: Fast mode
fields.help: Fast tree search (less thorough; comparable to FastTree).

fields.label: Skip ML distances
fields.help: Skip ML pairwise distance computation and BIONJ starting tree.

fields.label: CMAPLE algorithm
fields.help: Use the CMAPLE algorithm when sequence divergence is low (e.g. viral data).

fields.label: Force CMAPLE
fields.help: Force CMAPLE regardless of divergence.

fields.label: CMAPLE search type
fields.help: Tree search intensity for the CMAPLE algorithm.

fields.label: Disable local reference
fields.help: Disable use of multiple local references in CMAPLE.

fields.label: Mutation-annotated tree
fields.help: Infer mutations along each branch and output a mutation-annotated tree.

fields.label: UFBoot replicates
fields.help: Number of ultrafast bootstrap replicates. Minimum 1000.

fields.label: Optimise UFBoot trees
fields.help: Additional NNI step to optimise UFBoot trees, reducing over-support.

fields.label: Bootstrap resampling
fields.help: Resampling strategy for PARTITIONED data only: GENE (by gene) or GENESITE (by site within gene). Leave blank for standard site resampling.

fields.label: Max UFBoot iterations
fields.help: Maximum number of iterations to stop (UFBoot convergence).

fields.label: Convergence check interval
fields.help: Iteration interval for checking UFBoot convergence.

fields.label: Min correlation coefficient
fields.help: Minimum correlation coefficient for UFBoot convergence criterion.

fields.label: RELL epsilon
fields.help: Small epsilon to break ties in RELL evaluation.

fields.label: Write bootstrap trees
fields.help: Write UFBoot trees to .ufboot file (without branch lengths).

fields.label: Write bootstrap trees (with BL)
fields.help: Write UFBoot trees with branch lengths to .ufboot file.

fields.label: Bootstrap replicates
fields.help: Standard nonparametric bootstrap: analyse original alignment + N bootstrap replicates. Minimum 100.

fields.label: Bootstrap only (no original)
fields.help: Like -b but omits analysis on the original alignment.

fields.label: Bootstrap trees only
fields.help: Only perform bootstrap analysis; skip ML on original alignment.

fields.label: SH-aLRT replicates
fields.help: SH-like approximate likelihood ratio test. Use ≥1000 replicates; 0 = parametric aLRT.

fields.label: aBayes test
fields.help: Approximate Bayes branch support.

fields.label: Local bootstrap probability
fields.help: Fast local bootstrap probability. Minimum 1000 replicates.

fields.label: Reconstruct ancestral sequences
fields.help: Write marginal ancestral sequences for all nodes to a .state file.

fields.label: Min posterior probability
fields.help: Minimum posterior probability threshold for best ancestral state output.

fields.label: Tree set file
fields.help: File containing trees to compare with topology tests.

fields.label: RELL replicates
fields.help: Number of RELL bootstrap replicates for topology tests (KH, SH, WKH, WSH, ELW).

fields.label: Weighted KH/SH tests
fields.help: Additionally perform weighted KH and weighted SH tests.

fields.label: AU test
fields.help: Additionally perform the approximately unbiased (AU) test.

fields.label: Compute consensus
fields.help: Compute a majority-rule consensus tree from the tree set passed via -t.

fields.label: Consensus network
fields.help: Compute a consensus network from the tree set.

fields.label: Min support threshold
fields.help: Minimum support fraction to retain branches in the consensus (0.0–1.0).

fields.label: Burn-in
fields.help: Number of initial trees to discard as burn-in.

fields.label: Support mapping target tree
fields.help: Map bootstrap support from the tree set onto this target tree.

fields.label: Node tag for tree IDs
fields.help: Assign IDs of trees where this node appears to the node label.

fields.label: Support scale factor
fields.help: Scaling factor for support values (default 100 = percentages).

fields.label: Support precision
fields.help: Decimal precision for support values.

fields.label: Reference tree set
fields.help: Compute pairwise RF distances between -t tree set and this reference set.

fields.label: All-to-all RF distances
fields.help: Compute all pairwise RF distances within the tree set passed via -t.

fields.label: Adjacent RF distances
fields.help: Compute RF distances between consecutive (adjacent) trees.

fields.label: Random Yule-Harding tree (N taxa)
fields.help: Generate a random tree for N taxa under the Yule-Harding model.

fields.label: Random uniform tree (N taxa)
fields.help: Generate a random tree under the uniform model.

fields.label: Random caterpillar tree (N taxa)
fields.help: Generate a random caterpillar tree.

fields.label: Random balanced tree (N taxa)
fields.help: Generate a random balanced tree (N must be a power of 2).

fields.label: Random circular split network (N taxa)
fields.help: Generate a random circular split network.

fields.label: Branch length spec
fields.help: Three space-separated floats: min, mean, and max branch lengths for the random tree.

fields.label: Quartet sample size
fields.help: Number of random quartets to draw for likelihood mapping, or ALL.

fields.label: Cluster file
fields.help: NEXUS file with taxon cluster assignments for likelihood mapping.

fields.label: Write quartet likelihoods
fields.help: Write quartet log-likelihoods to .lmap.quartetlh file.

fields.label: Min branch length
fields.help: Minimum allowed branch length.

fields.label: Max branch length
fields.help: Maximum allowed branch length.

fields.label: Fix branch lengths
fields.help: Fix branch lengths from the tree passed via -t or -te.

fields.label: Collapse near-zero branches
fields.help: Collapse branches near zero length to produce a multifurcating tree.

fields.label: Log-likelihood epsilon
fields.help: Convergence epsilon for final model parameter estimation.

fields.label: Write alignment info
fields.help: Print alignment site statistics to .alninfo file.

fields.label: Write site log-likelihoods
fields.help: Write site log-likelihoods to .sitelh file.

fields.label: Write site LL per rate category
fields.help: Write site log-likelihoods per rate category.

fields.label: Write site LL per mixture class
fields.help: Write site log-likelihoods per mixture class.

fields.label: Write site LL per mixture+rate
fields.help: Write site log-likelihoods per mixture class and rate category.

fields.label: Write site posteriors per rate
fields.help: Write site posterior probabilities per rate category.

fields.label: Write site posteriors per mixture
fields.help: Write site posterior probabilities per mixture class.

fields.label: Write site posteriors per mixture+rate
fields.help: Write site posterior probabilities per mixture class and rate category.

fields.label: Write locally optimal trees
fields.help: Write all locally optimal trees encountered during search to .treels.

fields.label: Write partition log-likelihoods
fields.help: Write per-partition log-likelihoods to .partlh file.

fields.label: Constant site counts
fields.help: Comma-separated list of constant site counts to add to alignment (e.g. for morphological data).
